rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CVI Of the Complexion or Temperament of Body
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source begins a distinct natal chapter about traditional bodily temperament.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Printed CVI/editorial CVII; not a clinical diagnostic model.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author acknowledges many different temperaments among individuals and species.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical theory rather than verified health evidence.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Parental temperament is offered as one contributing source.
Lilly also attributes differences to configurations of celestial bodies.
Sanguine is classified as hot and moist in the four-humour system.
Phlegmatic is classified as cold and moist.
Choleric is classified as hot and dry.
Melancholic is classified as cold and dry.
Lilly gives an ordered list of five chart testimony categories.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Procedural list, not empirical psychometric proof.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: First category: zodiac sign rising at birth.
The ruling planet of the rising sign is also counted.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Different than just the sign quality.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Second category considers planets physically placed in the first house.
The second category includes lunar nodes if at the Ascendant.
The second category also includes planets aspecting the Ascendant.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon and planets behold her within moiety of orbs
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Third category: Moon and any planet aspecting it within the moiety of their permitted orbs.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Moiety rule differs from unrestricted aspect selection.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Quarter of year or Sign Sun in
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Fourth category: season of year or the sign containing the Sun.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Season and sign are not automatically separate independent evidence.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Fifth category: the dominant planet identified in the preceding chapter.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Prior ranking itself has multiple candidate algorithms.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: qualities of Significators and Signes orderly examined
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The qualities of selected planets and signs must be evaluated in order.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Original sequencing, not a frozen numeric program.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn or Mars behold Ascendant or Moon malevolent aspect
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: When Saturn or Mars forms an unfavorable aspect to Ascendant or Moon, Lilly adds their adverse qualities.
He says the adverse quality must be included even if all other testimonies agree.
rules.original_source_qualifications: An override or mixture exception, not a simple majority vote.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Saturn is assigned cold/moist qualities in its oriental condition.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Traditional planetary phase, not literal planet surface temperature.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Saturn is assigned dryness in its occidental condition.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source does not add a heat/cold pair to this row.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Jupiter is hot/moist when oriental.
Jupiter is moist when occidental.
Mars is hot/dry when oriental.
Mars is dry when occidental.
Venus is assigned hot/moist when oriental.
Venus is assigned moist when occidental.
Mercury is assigned heat when oriental.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source abbreviated to a single quality.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mercury is dry when occidental.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source abbreviated to a single quality.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: new Moon to first quarter hot and moist
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The Moon from new to first quarter is hot/moist.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: first quarter to full hot and dry
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: From first quarter to full Moon is hot/dry.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: full Moon to last quarter cold and dry
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: From full Moon to last quarter is cold/dry.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: last quarter to new cold and moist
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: From last quarter to new Moon is cold/moist.
The north lunar node is analogized to Jupiter.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source analogical assignment, not verified effect.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: South node as Saturn and Mars
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The south lunar node is analogized to Saturn and Mars.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Spring Aries Taurus Gemini hot moist
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: When Sun is in spring signs Aries/Taurus/Gemini it is assigned hot/moist.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Seasonal zodiac grouping presumes Northern Hemisphere period context.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Summer Cancer Leo Virgo hot dry
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Summer Sun signs Cancer/Leo/Virgo give hot/dry.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Autumn Libra Scorpio Sagittarius cold dry
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Autumn Sun signs Libra/Scorpio/Sagittarius give cold/dry.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Winter Capricorn Aquarius Pisces cold moist
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Winter Sun signs Capricorn/Aquarius/Pisces give cold/moist.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Fiery Aries Leo Sagittarius hot dry
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Fire triplicity is assigned hot/dry and associated with choleric temperament.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Distinct sign-quality testimony from solar season.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Earthly Taurus Virgo Capricorn cold dry
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Earth signs are assigned cold/dry, traditionally melancholic.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Aery Gemini Libra Aquarius hot moist
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Air signs are hot/moist, traditionally sanguine.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Watry Cancer Scorpio Pisces cold moist
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Water signs are cold/moist, traditionally phlegmatic.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: collect testimonies Hot Moist Cold Dry
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: After gathering selected qualities, Lilly instructs tallying hot, moist, cold and dry testimonies.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Scoring algorithm depends on earlier inclusion/orb choices.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The predominant quality pair determines the labeled complexion.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Requires comparator counts across opposing pairs.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Heat and moisture dominating implies sanguine.
Cold and moisture dominating implies phlegmatic.
Heat and dryness dominating implies choleric.
Cold and dryness dominating implies melancholic.
If a hot and cold opposition has equal testimonies, Lilly treats them as contradictory.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: one takes off the other not numbered
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Opposed testimonies of equal force cancel and are not counted.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Explicit cancellation rather than sum of conflicting positive labels.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Testimonies without a counterbalancing contradiction are retained.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Cancellation applies where source asserts opposition.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord Geniture and Horoscope triple vertue
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: When a single planet is both Lord of Geniture and Ascendant ruler, count its influence threefold.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Conditional triple count, not all lords always tripled.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: When the Moon occupies the Ascendant, count her testimonies twice.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: practicall part see our subsequent Nativity
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He refers readers to later worked nativity practice.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No independently verified human case is introduced on this page.
